description: This file defines the NotesController class, which manages note-related functionalities such as selection, deletion, tagging, pinning, starring, archiving, and UI interactions within a note-taking application. It interacts with various services and controllers to handle user actions and application state.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: Controller class managing note operations, UI state, and interactions within the note-taking app.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up references and destroys object properties when the controller is deallocated.

methods.name: setServicesPostConstruction
methods.description: Initializes the controller with an ItemListController instance and sets up observers.

methods.name: get selectedNotes
methods.description: Returns the list of currently selected notes.

methods.name: get firstSelectedNote
methods.description: Returns the first selected note, if any.

methods.name: get selectedNotesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of selected notes.

methods.name: get trashedNotesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of trashed notes.

methods.name: setContextMenuOpen
methods.description: Sets the context menu open state.

methods.name: setContextMenuClickLocation
methods.description: Sets the location where the context menu was clicked.

methods.name: setContextMenuPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the context menu.

methods.name: setContextMenuMaxHeight
methods.description: Sets the maximum height of the context menu.

methods.name: reloadContextMenuLayout
methods.description: Calculates and sets the layout for the context menu based on viewport and footer size.

methods.name: changeSelectedNotes
methods.description: Applies a mutation to all selected notes.

methods.name: setHideSelectedNotePreviews
methods.description: Hides or shows previews of selected notes.

methods.name: setLockSelectedNotes
methods.description: Locks or unlocks selected notes.

methods.name: setTrashSelectedNotes
methods.description: Trashes or restores selected notes.

methods.name: deleteNotesPermanently
methods.description: Permanently deletes selected notes.

methods.name: deleteNotes
methods.description: Deletes notes, either soft or permanent deletion.

methods.name: togglePinSelectedNotes
methods.description: Toggles pin state for selected notes.

methods.name: toggleStarSelectedNotes
methods.description: Toggles star state for selected notes.

methods.name: setPinSelectedNotes
methods.description: Sets pin state for selected notes.

methods.name: setStarSelectedNotes
methods.description: Sets star state for selected notes.

methods.name: setArchiveSelectedNotes
methods.description: Archives or unarchives selected notes.

methods.name: setProtectSelectedNotes
methods.description: Protects or unprotects selected notes.

methods.name: unselectNotes
methods.description: Deselects all notes.

methods.name: getSpellcheckStateForNote
methods.description: Returns the spellcheck state for a specific note.

methods.name: toggleGlobalSpellcheckForNote
methods.description: Toggles global spellcheck setting for a note.

methods.name: addTagToSelectedNotes
methods.description: Adds a tag to all selected notes.

methods.name: removeTagFromSelectedNotes
methods.description: Removes a tag from all selected notes.

methods.name: isTagInSelectedNotes
methods.description: Checks if a tag is present in all selected notes.

methods.name: setShowProtectedWarning
methods.description: Shows or hides the protected warning.

methods.name: emptyTrash
methods.description: Empties the trash after user confirmation.

methods.name: getSelectedNotesList
methods.description: Returns an array of selected notes.
